page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There is no integrated GPU hardware available on this instance profile.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g6t.large offers a dedicated CPU allocation for predictable compute performance in an entry-level dual-core configuration. This resource density makes it suitable for general-purpose workloads such as lightweight web serving, small databases, and basic application hosting that require dedicated CPU resources but do not demand high local disk I/O or GPU acceleration.
